mapper.select:
SELECT J2.* FROM ( SELECT A.*,B.COMPANY_NAME,B.USER_TYPE FROM TBL_ROUTER_INFO A LEFT JOIN (select * from TBL_COMPANY_INFO) B ON A.COMPANY_CODE=B.COMPANY_CODE )J2 where 1=1
and J2.company_code = #{companyCode}
and reg_date between #{sDate} and #{eDate}
and device_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchValue},'%')
and model_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchValue},'%')
and company_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchValue},'%')
and ( device_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchValue},'%') or model_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchValue},'%') or company_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchValue},'%') )
ORDER BY reg_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_ROUTER_INFO (device_id,device_name, model_name, volte_num, keywords, company_code, car_num, update_date, maker_phone_1, maker_phone_2, reg_date, extra_info, created_by) VALUES ( concat(#{companyCode},'_',#{deviceName},DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s')), concat(#{companyCode},'_',#{deviceName}), concat(#{modelName},'-',#{companyCode},'_',#{deviceName}), #{volteNum}, #{keywords}, #{companyCode}, #{carNum}, #{updateDate}, #{makerPhone1}, #{makerPhone2}, curdate(), #{extraInfo}, now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_ROUTER_INFO SET device_name = concat(#{companyCode},'_',#{deviceName}), model_name = concat(#{modelName},'-',#{companyCode},'_',#{deviceName}), volte_num = #{volteNum}, keywords = #{keywords}, company_code = #{companyCode}, car_num = #{carNum}, update_date = #{updateDate}, maker_phone_1 = #{makerPhone1}, maker_phone_2 = #{makerPhone2}, extra_info = #{extraInfo}, updated_by = now() WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}
